chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir Al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) was asked about the young child who cups the woman. He (peace be upon him) said: 'If he is good at it and can describe it, then [it is permissible/no objection].'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a young boy performing cupping on a woman according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) clarifies the condition of *ghayr mahram* (non-mahram) interaction by linking the permissibility of a young boy performing cupping on a woman to his level of maturity and competence. The criterion 'if he knows how to describe' (yusrifu) indicates that the prohibition is lifted when the boy possesses sufficient discernment and skill to perform the act without unnecessary exposure or error, reflecting the Shia juristic principle that physical proximity for medical necessity is permissible when modesty and competence are maintained.
